content: isbot (v5.2.0 per npm registry) is the standard UA-string bot/crawler detection package - regex-based against a regularly-updated bot-signature list, covers facebookexternalhit/Twitterbot/Slackbot/WhatsApp/LinkedInBot/Googlebot/Discordbot etc. API: isbot(userAgentString) returns boolean; also exposes find()/matches()/exclude()/extend(). Framework-agnostic - pass request.headers['user-agent'] manually in Fastify, no dedicated Fastify integration package needed.
